parameters.help_en: The Space ID of the Independent Software Vendor (ISV) sub-customer or the instance ID of the direct customers. This is the channel ID. You can find the channel ID on the Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page
parameters.help_zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看
parameters.name: cust_space_id

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

OK: The request was successful.

For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）

MarketingMessagesCostPerDelivered.description_en: The average cost per delivered message
MarketingMessagesCostPerDelivered.description_zh: 每条送达消息的平均费用

MarketingMessagesCostPerLinkBtnClick.description_en: The average cost per message link click. This metric excludes messages sent to Europe, Argentina, Türkiye, South Korea, and Japan
MarketingMessagesCostPerLinkBtnClick.description_zh: 每次消息链接点击的平均费用。这项指标不包括发送到欧洲、阿根廷、土耳其、韩国和日本的消息

MarketingMessagesDelivered.description_en: The number of messages that are sent by the business and successfully delivered to users. Some messages may fail to deliver if a user's device is unavailable. This metric excludes messages delivered to Europe and Japan. In some cases, this metric is an estimate. The value may differ from the data on your bill due to minor discrepancies during data processing
MarketingMessagesDelivered.description_zh: 商家向用户发送并成功送达的消息数量。部分消息可能无法送达，例如用户设备无法使用时。这项指标不包括送达至欧洲和日本的消息。在某些情况下，该指标可能为预估值，且由于数据处理过程中存在细微差异，其值可能与您结算单上显示的数据不一致

MarketingMessagesLinkBtnClick.description_en: The number of times users click or tap a marketing message that take users to an on-Meta or off-Meta destination, as specified by the advertiser. This metric excludes messages sent to Europe, Argentina, Türkiye, South Korea, and Japan
MarketingMessagesLinkBtnClick.description_zh: 用户在营销消息中执行点击或轻触操作的次数，这些操作将引导用户前往广告主指定的 Meta 技术站内或站外目标位置。这项指标不包括发送到欧洲、阿根廷、土耳其、韩国和日本的消息

MarketingMessagesLinkBtnClickRate.description_en: The percentage of delivered messages that received a link click. This metric excludes messages sent to Europe, Argentina, Türkiye, South Korea, and Japan
MarketingMessagesLinkBtnClickRate.description_zh: 获得链接点击的送达消息占送达消息总数的百分比。这项指标不包括发送到欧洲、阿根廷、土耳其、韩国和日本的消息

MarketingMessagesReadRate.description_en: The number of read messages divided by the number of delivered messages. The read status of some messages may not be captured if a customer disables read receipts. This metric excludes messages sent to Europe and Japan
MarketingMessagesReadRate.description_zh: 已读消息数除以送达消息数。系统可能未捕捉到部分消息的已读状态，例如当客户关闭已读回执时。这项指标不包括发送到欧洲和日本的消息

MarketingMessagesSpend.description_en: The total amount spent on a campaign, message group, or message during over its lifetime
MarketingMessagesSpend.description_zh: 在整个投放期为消息营销活动、消息组或消息花费的总金额

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: successful.

false: failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
